scripts.setup: npm ci && cd web-client && npm ci
scripts.frontend-build: cd web-client && npm ci && npm run build && cd ..
scripts.build: npm run server-build && npm run frontend-build
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npx dotenv-cli -e .env.local -- tsx watch --ignore web-client server/src/index.ts
scripts.test: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && cross-env PGUSER=robosim PGPASSWORD=robosim_postgres PGDATABASE=robosim_db PGHOST=localhost PGPORT=5433 NODE_ENV=test mocha --require tsx server/src/test/*.spec.ts --exit --sync --timeout 5000
scripts.db:up: docker compose --env-file .env.local -f infrastructure/docker-compose.yml -f infrastructure/docker-compose.prod.yml -f infrastructure/docker-compose.local.yml up -d postgres
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose --env-file .env.local -f infrastructure/docker-compose.yml -f infrastructure/docker-compose.prod.yml -f infrastructure/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm flyway
scripts.start:local: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run app:local
